surface_follow.label: Follow surfaces
surface_follow.description: Dragging moves the view center along terrain and object surfaces. Turn it off to keep the current height and pass through obstacles.

orbit_obstacle.label: Third-person collision

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Stops the camera control just short of the obstacle. It can sink one block into a wall or ceiling.

climb.label: Climb over
climb.description: Tilts the camera up to climb over what blocks it. Stops where the way up is blocked too; zooming in there drops it under the ceiling.

orbit_obstacle.description: Controls what happens when zooming, turning, or tilting would move the camera into terrain or an object.

ray_steps.label: Ray steps
ray_steps.description: Colors each point on screen by how much work it took to draw: blue for little, red for a lot. Points that borrowed a nearby result and skipped the work are grey.
